== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
{{Migrating Ancestor
| origin = Ireland
| destination = New Zealand
| origin-flag = European_Flags-29.png
| destination-flag = Flags-19.png }}
{{New Zealand Sticker | place=Avondale | region=Auckland}}
Robert was born about 1830.
<ref>Based on death 1914 age 84.</ref>
He was the son of William Glasgow, and lived at Montober, Kildress, County Tyrone as of 1857.<ref name="m"/> His mother was called Mary.<ref>She was the informant for daughter Sarah's birth in 1864.</ref>

On 15 Sep 1857 at the Brigh Presbyterian Meeting House (parish Ballyclog, Co. Tyrone), he married Ann Sloan of Annaghone, daughter of John Sloan, farmer. Witnessed by David Glasgow and John Sloan.
<ref name="m">[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/3c8fa43269664 Robert Glasgow, Ann Sloan, 1857, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

They emigrated to New Zealand as Assisted Immigrants on the ''Empress'' arriving at Auckland on 14 May 1865. Passengers: "Robert, Ann, William, Samuel & Sarah Glasgow".
<ref>[https://paperspast.natlib.govt.nz/newspapers/NZ18650512.2.3?query=glasgow "Shipping Intelligence"], ''New Zealander'', Volume XXII, Issue 2427, 12 May 1865, Page 2, Page 2</ref>

Robert purchased a farm at Patumahoe and worked there for a number of years. 
<ref name="sam_ob">[https://paperspast.natlib.govt.nz/newspapers/FRTIM19310911.2.24 "Obituary - Mr Samuel Glasgow"], ''Franklin Times'', Volume XXI, Issue 101, 11 September 1931, Page 5</ref>
The farm was called "Woodgrove", near "The Springs".
<ref>[https://paperspast.natlib.govt.nz/newspapers/FRTIM19360501.2.27 "Octogenarian Passes"], ''Franklin Times'', Volume XXVI, Issue 49, 1 May 1936, Page 5</ref>

He passed away 5 Aug 1914 age 84. at Avondale, Auckland, New Zealand.
<ref>NZ BDM Death search: 1914/10741	Glasgow	Robert	84Y</ref>
<ref>"New Zealand, Archives New Zealand, Probate Records, 1843-1998," database with images, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:Q2XL-WRXD : 9 March 2021), Robert Glasgow, 1914; citing , , record number 9649, Archives New Zealand, Auckland Regional Office; FamilySearch digital folder 101386236.</ref>
He is buried at Waikumete Cemetery.
<ref>[https://www.aucklandcouncil.govt.nz/cemeteries/Pages/RecordDetails.aspx?recordId=D868FAC9676056896251BA4EBB37ACFC Robert Glasgow] at Auckland CC Cemeteries search, accessed 23 Apr 2021</ref>

As of 1931 his surviving children were recorded as: William (Tuakau), Joseph (Kohekohe), Robert (Waimauku), Walter (Henderson), Mrs. James Hunter (Patumahoe), Mrs Willoughby (Avondale).

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-585]] is assessed at 97% (proved). Robert’s 1857 Brigh marriage account names William as father and places Robert at Montober. David witnesses that marriage, linking him into the supported sibling group and distinguishing this father from the younger same-name William.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare original 1857 marriage and Robert’s 1914 NZ death parents.

Source basis already held: [https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/3c8fa43269664 Robert Glasgow, Ann Sloan, 1857, Cookstown (https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/3c8fa43269664) at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


Marriage record matched as their daughter Sarah Ann b. 1864 has a matching NZ death record 1865 age 1;  and middle name ''Sloane'' occurs in their daughter Lillian.

The will mentions wife Nancy Ann and Robert's daughter Gertrude Maud.
A [https://paperspast.natlib.govt.nz/newspapers/AS19160805.2.92 memoriam notice] appeared in the newspaper "Inserted by Nancy M Glasgow and Gertie".   (Maybe the "M" is an audio error for "Ann").

Gertie was not listed as a child in the 1931 news clipping and does not seem to be in NZ BDM Births. Based on her death 1952/19409 age 66 and an 1892 school record, she seems to have been born around 1885. (Mary would have been 51).  So perhaps she was illegitimate or adopted (although Nancy testifies in the will that she was Robert's daughter).
